# Rushikesh Chavan

> Portfolio of Rushikesh Chavan, a DevOps Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer based in Pune, Maharashtra, India.

Rushikesh Chavan has 3+ years of experience building and operating cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes platforms, and reliable production systems. His work includes AWS, Terraform, Docker, GitOps, observability, and backend platforms.

## Selected work

- AIOps-enabled e-commerce microservices platform on AWS EKS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Prometheus, Grafana, and AWS Bedrock.
- Cloud-native MERN platform with DevSecOps checks, Kubernetes, Helm, Jenkins, and GitOps.
- Maharashtra Foreign Scholarship Portal serving seven state departments.
- MYYVO multivendor e-commerce platform with payments, logistics integrations, and Redis caching.
